assumptions: Settled gross is compared against transaction GMV for the NovaMart merchant group only.
caveats: Volume spike 25 Oct–31 Oct: attempt volume was +39% versus the usual level for those weekdays. Real business events (sales) and data gaps both look like this, so check before comparing totals across this period. It is not a data error by itself and is flagged for context.
Settlement for 31 Oct GMV falls after the data cut-off, so settled amounts understate that final day until T+1 settlement arrives.

facts.text: NovaMart's transaction GMV for 25–31 October 2026 was ₹436,684,668.47, against settled gross of ₹366,716,092.10.
Settled net was ₹357,581,099.75, after refunds of ₹4,086,230.59 and fees (MDR) of ₹5,048,761.76.
GMV on 31 Oct (₹69,968,576.37) had not settled by the data cut-off, because it settles T+1.
Multi-day batches for NovaMart Electronics, Fashion and Grocery covering 25–26 Oct settled on 28 Oct. They fall fully inside the window, so they have no net effect on the total.
The unexplained residual is ₹0.00 (0.0%), and no settlement batches were flagged.
Attempt volume over the period was +39% versus the usual level for those weekdays.

response.headline: Yes, NovaMart's settlements reconcile with its transaction GMV for 25–31 October, with no unexplained gap. Of ₹43.67 crore GMV, ₹36.67 crore was settled gross, and the difference is fully accounted for by timing, refunds and fees.
